_comment: MIDDLE-EXIT = ATR STOP calibration. Forces UseATRStop=1, swapping the RSIOS failed-bounce middle exit for a hard ATR stop at PurchasePrice - StopATRMult×EntryATR. PIKK is UNCALIBRATED (baseline UseATRStop=0); run this to decide whether a fixed ATR stop beats the soft RSIOS exit. go run ./cmd/backtest -ticker PIKK -strategy reversion -interval Hour1 -calibrate data/params/pikk/reversion_cal_atrstop.json -out ./reports/PIKK_atrstop -months 12 -train-months 6 -test-months 3 -metric profit_factor -min-trades 20
